messages:
marco: Hey folks — can someone 👀 at this Terraform change? It's for attaching the new GPU-subnet to the compute cluster, need it merged before tomorrow's rollout. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/621

marco: TL;DR: adds aws_subnet.gpu, updates route table association, and tag propagation. Didn't touch NAT or IGW but would like a second pair of eyes on security groups.

priya: I'm tied up in a meeting now, but will check in ~1h. Quick q: does this require a CCR (change control)? Or is within standard infra patch?

alex_m: Skimmed — main thing I want confirmed is the 0.0.0.0/0 egress rule on module/gpu_sg, seems broad. Can you justify or narrow?

marco: Good catch — it's for BASTION outbound only, I'll narrow to specific ports and add comment. Here's the snippet I added:

```terraform
resource "aws_subnet" "gpu" {
  vpc_id            = var.vpc_id
  cidr_block        = "10.20.8.0/24"
  availability_zone = var.az
  tags = {
    Name = "gpu-subnet-${var.env}"
    Env  = var.env
  }
}

resource "aws_security_group_rule" "gpu_bastion_egress" {
  type                     = "egress"
  from_port                = 22
  to_port                  = 22
  protocol                 = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks              = ["198.51.100.0/24"]
  security_group_id        = module.bastion_sg.id
  description              = "Bastion -> GPU nodes (ssh)"
}
```

jonah: If you tighten that SG rule and add a changelog note, I'm fine to approve. Also run `terraform fmt` — noticed formatting nit.

marco: Done both, pushed a force-update. Also added a short changelog entry in PR description.

infra-bot: tfsec scan complete — no critical findings (0 high, 1 medium). See report: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/reports/tfsec/621

deploy-bot: plan step completed in staging: 5 resources to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy

priya: Approved. @alex_m @jonah any objections to merging? If none by EOD I'll merge and apply in staging tonight.

alex_m: No objections, go ahead. :thumbsup:

jonah: no blockers from me.

marco: Thanks all! I'll monitor staging apply and post status here. :rocket:
